name: selidle
algorithm: a producer sends 0..n-1 on a channel of capacity 64 and closes it, and a consumer sums them, while k other tasks sit parked in the std select over two channels nobody sends on until the end, which then closes one of them; prints the sum of the n values plus k (README.md).

skip.rust: Rust's std mpsc has no select over channels
skip.mk-wrap: the only arithmetic is the sum, which stays below 2^62

no_counts: B24 does not apply: the checksum shows every value arrived once and every select was released
notes: G-MISS-R3 and C-STDMISS-CONC-2: what one parked Select costs unrelated channel traffic. Run with k = 0 for the baseline (no Select parked). Both columns sleep 20 ms before the stream so the k selects are parked; the sleep is in every cell.
Concurrency row (B19): logical CPUs 0 and 2 (mask 0x5), 2 threads, as idiomatic/chan.
Written by std-missing, M6 fix round, 2026-11-07; checksums from the arithmetic (sum 0..n-1 plus k).
